headlines.description: — Jiri Kulich scored with 6:40 left and the Sabres overcame a two-goal deficit to beat the Chicago Blackhawks 4-3 in Buffalo’s home-opener on Saturday night.

headlines.shortLinkText: Lightning beat the Capitals 3-1 in home opener

headlines.shortLinkText: Senators open season with a 3-2 victory over the Maple Leafs

headlines.shortLinkText: Hurricanes beat the Flyers 3-2 in OT for their first win as Aho scores 2
